title: Invertibility of the canonical structure-sheaf base-change adjoint
statement: Let $k:X^{\prime}\to X$, $q:X^{\prime}\to Y^{\prime}$, $p:X\to Y$ and $g:Y^{\prime}\to Y$ be a cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with $p$ affine. The canonical map $g^*(p_*\mathcal O_X)\to q_*\mathcal O_{X^{\prime}}$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], defined as the adjoint of restriction along $k$ transported through the pushforward composition comparisons, is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 02KG, canonical affine tensor comparison; Tag 01CA, tensor functoriality and associativity.

proof.text: Compare the standard and tensor pullback adjunctions by uniqueness of left adjoints.
Identify the comparison with the composition of that isomorphism, the affine base-change map, and the pushed-forward tensor pullback-of-unit map by applying homEquiv and its naturality.
Each factor is an isomorphism by affine quasi-coherent base change and the tensor pullback unit characterization. Their composition is therefore invertible.

proof_origin.place: Tags 02KG and 01CA; explicit categorical reduction of the tensor comparison.

theorem canonical_structure_baseChange_isIso {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : X ⟶ Y) (q : X' ⟶ Y') (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (k : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback k q p g) [IsAffineHom p] :
    IsIso (((pullbackPushforwardAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm
      ((pushforward p).map (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit k.toRingCatSheafHom) ≫
        (pushforwardComp k p).hom.app (unit X') ≫
        (pushforwardCongr sq.w).hom.app (unit X') ≫
        (pushforwardComp q g).inv.app (unit X')))
